hook: The Queen's Telegram to the Whole Empire, 1897
text: On the morning of her Diamond Jubilee, the twenty-second of June, eighteen ninety-seven, the Queen went to the telegraph room at Buckingham Palace and pressed an electric button. Her message flashed out along the wires to every corner of the Empire. It said: From my heart I thank my beloved people. May God bless them. Then, at seventy-eight, she rode through six miles of cheering streets to St Paul's Cathedral.
